claims: The Artemis II crew consists of NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman (commander), Victor Glover (pilot), Christina Koch (mission specialist), and CSA astronaut Jeremy Hansen (mission specialist).
The Artemis II crew returned to Earth on April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II crew's mission lasted 10 days.
The Artemis II crew were the first humans to travel to the moon and back in over 50 years.
Reid Wiseman is a Navy veteran.
Reid Wiseman previously served as Chief of NASA's Astronaut Office.
Victor Glover is a Navy pilot.
Victor Glover flew on the SpaceX Crew-1 mission.
Victor Glover is the first person of color to go to the Moon.
Christina Koch holds the record for the longest single spaceflight by a woman.
Christina Koch is the first woman to go to the Moon.
Jeremy Hansen is a Royal Canadian Air Force fighter pilot.
Jeremy Hansen is the first Canadian to travel to the Moon.
The Artemis II crew tested the Orion spacecraft's life support systems.
The Artemis II crew conducted manual maneuvers during their 10-day flight.
The Artemis II crew's 10-day flight included a reentry into Earth's atmosphere on April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II crew splashed down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of California.
